high_level_goal.name: Facilitate service discovery and booking for event organizers
high_level_goal.description: Provide a centralized platform where event organizers can discover, select, and book event-related services from verified providers.

actor.name: Event Organizer
actor.description: Person creating and managing an event, coordinating services and payments.

low_level_goals.name: Browse and select event services
low_level_goals.description: The event organizer searches and filters services by category, price, and availability, then selects one for booking.

high_level_associated.name: Facilitate service discovery and booking for event organizers
high_level_associated.description: Provide a centralized platform where event organizers can discover, select, and book event-related services from verified providers.
